req.title: Task description accepts long text
req.statement: The system shall accept task descriptions up to at least 1000 characters.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-032 requires the system to accept task descriptions up to at least 1000 characters. However, inspection of the SUT source (schemas.py) reveals that TaskBase.description has max_length=500. This means the requirement as stated (1000 chars) CANNOT be satisfied by the current implementation — the system will reject descriptions >500 chars with HTTP 422. Tests must reflect the ACTUAL SUT behaviour: (1) positive: description at exactly 500 chars (schema max) is accepted with HTTP 201; (2) boundary BVA: description at 501 chars is rejected with HTTP 422 (schema enforces max_length=500); (3) negative: description at 1000 chars is rejected with HTTP 422 (the requirement gap); (4) additional boundary: description at 499 chars accepted; (5) description at 1 char accepted. All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient with an in-memory SQLite DB to avoid state leakage. The tests are designed to kill mutations on the max_length constant (500), the HTTP status codes (201 vs 422), and the comparison operators in Pydantic validation.

tests.executable:
import os, sys
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import get_db

engine_mem = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
SessionMem = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem)

def override_get_db():
    db = SessionMem()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

desc_500 = 'X' * 500
payload = {'title': 'Valid Task', 'description': desc_500, 'completed': False}
r = client.post('/tasks/', json=payload)
assert r.status_code == 201
body = r.json()
assert 'id' in body
assert body['title'] == 'Valid Task'
assert body['description'] == desc_500
assert len(body['description']) == 500
assert body['completed'] == False

app.dependency_overrides.clear()
